title: The Lost Book Is Found
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and finds, and tonight the workers in the temple find the lost book of God’s words: Scout finds Grandma’s lost Bible in the back of the closet and hears her favorite verse.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to look for hidden things, and tonight the workers find a treasure no one knew was there. In Scout’s world today: Scout is helping Grandma clean the hall closet. Way in the back, under a pile of old blankets, Scout finds a book with a soft brown cover. It is Grandma’s first Bible, full of her pencil notes and one pressed flower. Grandma hugs it and says, “I thought this was lost!” Then she reads Scout her favorite verse out loud. Just like the workers in the temple, Scout learned that God’s words are a treasure worth finding.
